comparisons.test: /mcp panel stays live while a server connect is pending and subcommands await the settle

discriminatingCase.test: sign-in completes for one server while another is still connecting
discriminatingCase.reason: One server's connect is held open on a gate while the OAuth server signs in: the manager reports the gated server connecting, the panel stays interactive and the sign-in completes. A design that awaited the handshakes before publishing the snapshot, or before dispatching a subcommand, fails this case.

discriminatingCase.test: on_turn_start leaves a needs-auth server alone when the stored tokens are unchanged
discriminatingCase.reason: The unchanged-fingerprint turn keeps the server needs-auth and reconnects zero times, while a store mutated from a second owner changes the fingerprint, reconnects exactly once and exposes the tool. An unconditional per-turn reconnect and a no-pickup design both fail this pair.
